points.point: Powell said policy is moving to a level that will be "sufficiently restrictive" to return inflation to 2%
points.quote: We are moving our policy stance purposefully to a level that will be sufficiently restrictive to return inflation to 2 percent.
paraphrases: Powell said policy needs to become sufficiently restrictive to bring inflation back to 2%.
The Fed is moving toward a sufficiently restrictive stance to curb inflation, Powell said.
Policy will need to be sufficiently restrictive for some time, per Powell's Jackson Hole remarks.
decoys: Powell said policy was already adequately calibrated and needed no further tightening.
Powell said policy needed to become moderately accommodative to support growth.

points.point: Powell warned that fighting inflation will bring some pain to households and businesses
points.quote: While higher interest rates, slower growth, and softer labor market conditions will bring down inflation, they will also bring some pain to households and businesses.
paraphrases: Powell warned that fighting inflation will bring some pain to households and businesses.
He acknowledged tighter policy carries costs, including pain for households and firms.
Powell said reducing inflation means real pain for American households and businesses.
decoys: Powell said the transition to lower inflation would be painless for most households.
Powell said pain would be felt mainly by foreign economies, not U.S. households.

points.point: Powell said restrictive policy must be maintained for some time
points.quote: Restoring price stability will likely require maintaining a restrictive policy stance for some time. The historical record cautions strongly against prematurely loosening policy.
paraphrases: Powell said the Fed must keep policy restrictive for some time.
He signaled a sustained period of restrictive policy is likely needed.
Restrictive policy will need to stay in place for an extended period, Powell said.
decoys: Powell said restrictive policy would only be needed for a few more weeks.
Powell said policy could return to neutral almost immediately.

points.point: History warns against prematurely loosening policy
points.quote: Restoring price stability will likely require maintaining a restrictive policy stance for some time. The historical record cautions strongly against prematurely loosening policy.
paraphrases: He cautioned that history argues against loosening policy too soon.
Powell warned that prematurely easing policy would be a mistake, citing historical experience.
The historical record cautions against pivoting to rate cuts too early, Powell said.
decoys: Powell said the Fed could ease policy quickly once inflation ticked down.
Powell said history shows early policy loosening carries little risk.

points.point: Powell signaled it will likely become appropriate to slow the pace of rate increases at some point
points.quote: At some point, as the stance of monetary policy tightens further, it likely will become appropriate to slow the pace of increases.
paraphrases: Powell said it will likely become appropriate to slow the pace of rate increases at some point.
The Fed signaled smaller hikes ahead as the tightening cycle matures.
